🔊 ICCIMA to attend 40th ICCD Board Meeting in Ankara

📌 Tehran, IRNA – The Iran Chamber of Commerce, Industries, Mines, and Agriculture (ICCIMA) will participate in the 40th Board of Directors Meeting of the Islamic Chamber of Commerce and Development (ICCD) in Ankara, Turkiye.

The 40th Board of Directors meeting of the ICCD is set to occur on June 28–29, 2026, in Ankara. A delegation from the Iran Chamber of Commerce, headed by Samad Hassanzadeh, who leads the Chamber of Commerce, Industries, Mines, and Agriculture, will attend this event.
​
This meeting marks the first session of the organization’s new working term, during which elections for key management positions—including vice presidents and members of the executive and finance committees—will be held.
​
The agenda will also include strategic programs such as the development of the halal economy, an assessment of the Islamic Chamber’s educational academy, and bilateral meetings between Iran and other member countries to strengthen economic and trade cooperation.
